title: Rook CephObjectStore
description: Schema for the Rook CephObjectStore and CephObjectStoreUser Custom Resource Definitions, which provision Ceph RADOS Gateway (RGW) object storage endpoints on Kubernetes. CephObjectStore defines S3-compatible and Swift-compatible gateway configuration, pool settings, and zone membership. CephObjectStoreUser defines user credentials and capabilities for accessing the object store.

apiVersion.description: Kubernetes API version for the CephObjectStore resource

kind.description: Kubernetes resource kind, either CephObjectStore or CephObjectStoreUser

name.description: Name of the CephObjectStore or CephObjectStoreUser resource

namespace.description: Kubernetes namespace where the resource is deployed

labels.description: Key-value labels for Kubernetes resource organization

annotations.description: Key-value annotations for storing non-identifying metadata

CephObjectStoreSpec.description: Specification for a CephObjectStore defining RGW gateway, metadata pool, data pool, and zone settings

metadataPool.description: Configuration for the Ceph pool storing object metadata, bucket listings, and user data

dataPool.description: Configuration for the Ceph pool storing actual object data

gateway.description: Configuration for the Ceph RADOS Gateway (RGW) daemon providing the S3/Swift API

zone.description: Ceph multi-site zone configuration for replication across geographic regions

name.description: Name of the CephObjectZone CRD resource this store belongs to

preservePoolsOnDelete.description: If true, Ceph pools are preserved when the CephObjectStore CRD is deleted. If false, pools and all data are deleted.

healthCheck.description: Configuration for the periodic health check of the object store gateway

bucket.description: Health check settings using a dedicated bucket probe

disabled.description: Whether the bucket health check is disabled

security.description: KMS and SSE configuration for server-side encryption of stored objects

kms.description: Key Management Service configuration for server-side encryption

tokenSecretName.description: Name of the Kubernetes Secret containing the KMS authentication token
Kubernetes Secret name for S3 SSE credentials

GatewaySpec.description: Configuration for the Ceph RADOS Gateway (RGW) daemon providing S3 and Swift object storage endpoints

type.description: Gateway type, currently only s3 is supported

sslCertificateRef.description: Name of a Kubernetes Secret containing the TLS certificate and key for HTTPS access to the gateway

caBundleRef.description: Name of a Kubernetes ConfigMap containing a CA bundle for validating client certificates

port.description: HTTP port for the RGW service

securePort.description: HTTPS port for the RGW service when TLS is configured

instances.description: Number of RGW daemon instances to run. More instances provide higher throughput and availability.

annotations.description: Kubernetes annotations to apply to the RGW pod and service

labels.description: Kubernetes labels to apply to the RGW pods

resources.description: CPU and memory resource requests and limits for RGW daemon pods

priorityClassName.description: Priority class for RGW daemon pods

placement.description: Kubernetes pod placement settings for RGW daemons

externalRgwEndpoints.description: Endpoints of external RGW daemons when using an external Ceph cluster

ip.description: IP address of the external RGW endpoint

PoolSpec.description: Configuration for a Ceph pool used by the object store

failureDomain.description: Failure domain for pool data placement

deviceClass.description: OSD device class for pool placement

dataChunks.description: Number of data chunks per stripe

codingChunks.description: Number of parity chunks per stripe

CephObjectStoreUserSpec.description: Specification for a CephObjectStoreUser defining access credentials and capabilities for the object store

store.description: Name of the CephObjectStore resource this user belongs to

displayName.description: Human-readable display name for the object store user

capabilities.description: S3/Swift capability grants controlling what operations the user can perform

quotas.description: Storage quota limits for this user

clusterNamespace.description: Namespace of the Ceph cluster if different from the user resource namespace

ObjectUserCapabilities.description: Ceph RGW user capability grants for S3 and admin API access control

user.description: Permission level for user management operations

users.description: Permission level for users listing operations

buckets.description: Permission level for bucket administration operations

metadata.description: Permission level for object metadata operations

usage.description: Permission level for usage statistics operations

zone.description: Permission level for zone configuration operations

ObjectUserQuota.description: Storage quota limits for a CephObjectStoreUser

maxBuckets.description: Maximum number of buckets this user can create. Set to -1 for unlimited.

maxSize.description: Maximum total storage size for this user (e.g. 10Gi, 1Ti)

maxSizeBytes.description: Maximum storage size in bytes. Set to -1 for unlimited.

maxObjects.description: Maximum number of objects this user can store. Set to -1 for unlimited.

CephObjectStoreStatus.description: Observed state of the CephObjectStore as reported by the Rook operator

phase.description: Current lifecycle phase of the object store

conditions.description: Status conditions for the object store

info.description: Additional status information including endpoint URLs

endpoint.description: HTTP endpoint URL for the RGW service

secureEndpoint.description: HTTPS endpoint URL for the RGW service when TLS is configured

Condition.description: A Kubernetes-style condition for the object store resource

reason.description: Machine-readable reason for the condition status

message.description: Human-readable description of why the condition is in this state

lastTransitionTime.description: Time when this condition last transitioned
